aboutUs.title: About Us
aboutUs.description: All our members are absolutely professionals

stepContentFirst.step1: Click on the `Sign Up` or `Create Account` button on our homepage. Fill out the registration form with your details. Make sure to provide accurate information. Choose a unique username and a strong password. Your username will be your identity on our platform, so pick something memorable.
stepContentFirst.step2: `Access the dashboard` is your gateway to a world of possibilities within our platform. Once you log in, you'll find yourself in a centralized hub where you can navigate, manage, and explore all the features, tools, and information at your fingertips. From tracking your progress, connecting with others, to accessing resources, the dashboard is your control center for a seamless and productive experience.
stepContentFirst.step3: Tasks are a powerful tool for managing your to-do list and staying organized. To create a task, access your dashboard and locate the `Tasks` or `To-Do List` section. Click on the `Create Task` button. Fill in the task details, including a title, description, due date, and any relevant tags or categories. You can also set priority levels to help you prioritize your tasks. Once you've filled out the information, click `Save` or `Create` to add the task to your list. You can easily edit, mark as complete, or delete tasks as needed.
stepContentFirst.step4: Dive into the world of possibilities and features our application offers and relish the convenience it brings to your digital life.

stepContentSecond.step1: When you return to the platform in the future, simply click on the `Sign In` button. Enter your username and password. Click `Sign In` and you'll have access to your account
stepContentSecond.step2: When you `Access the dashboard` you open the door to a personalized experience tailored to your needs. This dynamic interface serves as your command center, offering real-time insights, notifications, and easy access to essential functions. Whether you're monitoring your account, customizing settings, or diving into your latest projects, the dashboard provides a user-friendly, intuitive hub for all your interactions within our platform.
stepContentSecond.step3: The feed is your source for the latest updates, news, and posts from other users or relevant information on our platform. To access the feed, click on the `Feed` or `News` section in your dashboard. Scroll through the feed to view posts, articles, and updates from your connections or relevant sources. You can like, comment, and share posts to engage with the community. Use filters or search options to narrow down the content you're interested in. Stay informed and connected by regularly checking the feed for valuable insights and updates.
stepContentSecond.step4: We've crafted this application with your enjoyment in mind, so take full advantage of its offerings and make your experience unforgettable.

settings.intDisconnectText: Disconnect {name}? All conversations from this channel will be deleted from the CRM.
settings.intEmbedHelp: Paste it just before the closing body tag on every page where the chat should appear.
settings.intTwilioAuto: Incoming SMS and calls are set up automatically. Calls from the browser need HTTPS and access to the microphone.
settings.intHelp_twilio: Enter your Twilio Account SID and Auth Token (console.twilio.com) and one of your Twilio numbers. The CRM configures the number and creates the keys for browser calls itself.
settings.intHelp_sip: Connect any SIP provider or PBX that supports SIP over WebSocket (wss://): Asterisk, FreeSWITCH, 3CX, FusionPBX and many cloud PBXs. Ask your provider for the WebSocket server address, SIP domain, username and password. The browser registers with the provider itself, so the CRM checks the login before saving.
settings.intChooseProvider: Choose your provider. If it is not in the list, pick “Other provider (manual)”: any operator or PBX with SIP over WebSocket (wss://) works.
settings.provHelp_telnyx: Telnyx: in the Telnyx Portal create a SIP connection with credentials and enter its username and password. The server address comes from the Telnyx documentation; we have not yet tested it on a live Telnyx account.
settings.provHelp_asterisk: Asterisk, FreePBX or Issabel on your server: enable WebRTC (WSS) for the extension. Enter the WebSocket address (Asterisk default: wss://your-server:8089/ws), the server domain, and the extension number with its password.
settings.provHelp_freeswitch: FreeSWITCH on your server: enable WSS (default port 7443). Enter the WebSocket address, the FreeSWITCH domain, and the user number with its password.
settings.intSipReplaces: This replaces your current SIP connection ({name}).
settings.intSipConnected: Calls are made and received in the browser through this provider, and every call is recorded in the CRM. Incoming calls ring only while a CRM tab is open.
settings.intHelp_telegram: Create a bot with @BotFather in Telegram and paste its token. People write to the bot, and the messages appear in Chat and Calls.
settings.intHelp_viber: Create a bot account at partners.viber.com and paste its authentication token. The webhook is registered automatically.
settings.intHelp_messenger: In Meta for Developers create an app with the Messenger product, paste the Page access token and the App secret, then enter Callback URL and Verify token (shown after connecting) into the app's Webhooks settings and subscribe to «messages».
settings.intHelp_webchat: A chat bubble for your website. Visitors write from the site, and you answer in Chat and Calls.
settings.intPollingInfo: Local mode: new messages are fetched while Chat and Calls is open. On a public https address the site switches to webhooks.
settings.intErrNeedHttps: Webhooks need a public https address. Set APP_URL (or open the site on its public domain), then press «Register webhook».
